company_profile: Emerging Travel Group is a travel-tech company building online hotel booking platforms and B2B APIs for travel agents, companies and individual travellers.
title: Senior Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years building ML models end to end, from SQL and PySpark pipelines to production services, across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Works with gradient boosting (LightGBM, XGBoost), classification, regression, reranking and embeddings, turning business problems into clear ML tasks with stakeholders. Ships models with FastAPI, Airflow and MLflow and keeps them measurable in production. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Search-to-Booking Conversion Model
bullets: Built a model predicting the probability that a hotel search converts into a booking, using LightGBM on price, availability and session features with embedding-based matching of room descriptions.
Evaluated it offline with ranking metrics and a simulated A/B test on held-out searches, then scheduled training in Airflow and served scores through a FastAPI microservice.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Data Scientist (Look-2-Book) role. I build classic ML end to end, from SQL and PySpark pipelines to LightGBM and XGBoost models running behind production APIs. What connects my work is turning a vague business question into a model that people can act on.

Emerging Travel Group builds the booking platforms that hotels, agents and travellers rely on, and predicting whether a search turns into a booking is the kind of problem I like: a clear metric, real revenue and messy data. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Portugal together and settle there long term.

At Viavi I deployed a LightGBM system that predicted SLA breaches and reduced downtime by 67%, served with FastAPI and MLflow. At Optum I built a reranker on top of an existing recommendation system that lifted renewal conversion by 2%. I would bring the same habit of tying models to business outcomes to your look-to-book work.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Building for teachers and children has taught me to check what a model does for real users before trusting a metric. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
